REFLECTIVE and RESILIENT
As headteacher of Marnel Infant School I am pleased to welcome you to our website. We are a happy, friendly school and we are always pleased to welcome visitors and show them around. Our broad and balanced curriculum is innovative, creative and fun. It is taught through exciting projects that underpin our learning values and reflects our rights respecting ethos, excellent ICT and interest in The Arts. We enjoy involving parents and the wider community in the life of the school as much as we can.
We hope that our website gives you a flavour of what we do, so please enjoy your visit!

Marnel - about our school
Marnel Infant School is a unique place to learn. Our dynamic teaching methods and aspirational ethos foster a lifelong zest for learning, resilience and a 'can do' attitude in our school community. Find out what makes us distinctive here!
Our school Vision and Values
100 Things at Marnel

Pastoral Support
At Marnel Infant School, we care about every child and their family. Our warm, nurturing pastoral approach helps children feel safe, happy and ready to learn.
We know that when children feel secure, valued and listened to, they can build positive relationships, grow in confidence and reach their full potential. We work closely with families and offer personalised pastoral support where needed, responding with care, understanding and compassion.
If you would like support, please speak to your child’s class teacher in the first instance. You can also contact our school office at adminoffice@marnel-inf.hants.sch.uk, who will pass your details to the pastoral team.
Pastoral Co-ordinator
Mrs Katie Sayer and Miss Nicola Langdon - senco@marnel-inf.hants.sch.uk
